what: SUMO 1.27.1 exits with a segmentation fault (exit code 245, EXC_BAD_ACCESS at address 0x70) when a vehicle with the bluelight device drives the ambulance route on the Dhaka network. Reproduced in plain SUMO, with no TraCI and no code of this project, on 2026-10-06.
demand: the uncalibrated generated demand (900 vehicles in 1,800 s), the ambulance departing at 900 s
with_this_projects_alert_code: 10 of 21 runs crashed in a first check over seeds 11 to 13 (arms no_alert, alert, alert_preemption), the no-alert baseline of seed 12 among them
suspected_cause_not_verified: MSDevice_Bluelight.cpp (v1_27_1), line 152: `upcomingLinks.push_back(l->getIncomingLanes()[0].viaLink)` for an internal lane reached from another internal lane; the two crashes that were traced happened on consecutive internal lanes of one junction. No debug build was used, so this is a reading of the source, not a diagnosis.
source_of_figures: the session's terminal output of the commands above; rerun them to check
newer_release: none: 1.27.1 is the newest eclipse-sumo on PyPI on 2026-10-06
